mainEntity.name: What are common challenges in fixture installation coordination and how are they avoided?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common challenges in fixture installation coordination include incompatible selections, delayed deliveries, and damage during transit. These issues can cause significant project delays and additional costs. Frasheski Construction avoids these by meticulous planning, checking specifications for compatibility, and proactive communication with suppliers and clients. We establish clear delivery schedules and conduct quality checks upon arrival, ensuring that fixtures are correct and undamaged before installation begins.
